notes: granite-speech-5.0-2b.litertlm of litert-community/granite-speech-5.0-2b: ibm-granite/granite-speech-5.0-2b (IBM's speech-language model for multilingual speech recognition and translation; 16 kHz audio in, the transcript out) converted to LiteRT-LM (litert-torch 0.10.0, litert-lm-builder 0.19.1); uploaded 2026-11-06 (Hub commit 64ad8a15); main 53f901f0 at the read, 2846558336 B, sha256 c90a3dae17d3399acbce3f9642a308d65bd0214134ce958562dbb2ef90337265. Measured 2026-11-07: the LM bench in run r5 (holds s26b, s26c: the B runs of an A B B A with the r5 candidate) and the clip timing in run r7 (holds s26a, s26b, in the same sessions as the update file: the card's Performance table). The 38-clip gate is in the 2026-11-06 snapshot.
quantization: language model: int8 weights with one scale per output channel (dynamic_wi8_afp32), KV cache 4,096 tokens, prefill signatures 64, 256 and 1,024 tokens, float32 activations declared for the GPU; token embedding table int8; audio encoder (log-mel front end, 16-layer conformer, 2-layer query transformer, projection): float16 weights computed in float32 (FLOAT_CASTING), one 36-second window, CPU only; model type generic_model
